store.summary: HDMI test patterns and audio tones for AV setup and troubleshooting
store.description: Turns the CardputerZero into a pocket AV test generator. Sends color bars, crosshatch, safe-area, ramps, solids, checkerboards and a judder test box over HDMI, with 1 kHz and left/right channel ID tones. Controlled from the keyboard with status on the built-in screen. Lip-sync measurement, EDID reader and SPL meter are coming.
